short_description.id: Pulao adalah naga Tiongkok yang termasuk sembilan anak naga, gemar meraung, dan karena itu digambarkan sebagai kait lonceng.
short_description.en: Pulao is a Chinese dragon counted among the nine dragon offspring, fond of roaring and therefore shown as the hook of bells.

long_description.id: Pulao adalah naga Tiongkok yang termasuk sembilan anak naga. Kegemarannya meraung dihubungkan dengan hiasan dan kait pada lonceng.
long_description.en: Pulao is a Chinese dragon counted among the nine dragon offspring. Its roaring explains why China places Pulao images on bells as suspension hooks.

long_description.id: Li Shan mencatat Pulao dalam komentarnya atas Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody. Kisah menjelaskan raungan Pulao sebagai reaksi terhadap paus yang ditakutinya. Sebuah catatan yang mengutip Xue Zong menyebut Pulao sejak dulu takut kepada paus dan menjerit keras ketika dipukulnya; agar lonceng berbunyi keras, Pulao dibuat di atasnya dan pemukulnya dinamai ikan paus.
long_description.en: Li Shan records Pulao in his commentary on the Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody. The tale explains Pulao's roar as a response to the whale it fears. A note quoting Xue Zong says Pulao has always feared the whale and cries out loudly when struck by it; to make a bell loud, a Pulao is made on top and the striker is named a whale.

long_description.id: Daftar Lu Rong pada zaman Ming menyertakan Pulao dengan nama Tulao, dan Shuyuan zaji menyebut Tulao berwujud seperti naga tetapi kecil, suka meraung, dan berkekuatan gaib sehingga lonceng digantungkan padanya. Kemudian Pulao dimasukkan ke berbagai daftar Sembilan Anak Naga oleh penulis Ming seperti Li Dongyang dan Yang Shen.
long_description.en: Lu Rong's Ming-period list includes Pulao under the name Tulao, and the Shuyuan zaji says the Tulao looks like a small dragon, likes to roar and has divine strength, so bells are hung from it. Pulao was later integrated into lists of the Nine Children of the Dragon by Ming authors such as Li Dongyang and Yang Shen.

description.id: Daftar Lu Rong menyebut Tulao bersifat suka meraung dan memiliki kekuatan gaib; menurut catatan lain Pulao menjerit keras ketika dipukul paus.
description.en: The list by Lu Rong says the Tulao is given to roaring and has divine strength; another note says Pulao cries out loudly when struck by the whale.

description.id: Pulao sejak dulu takut kepada ikan paus, dan menjerit keras setiap kali dipukulnya.
description.en: Pulao has always feared the whale and cries out loudly whenever it is struck.

note.id: Pulao termasuk dalam daftar Sembilan Anak Naga.
note.en: Pulao is counted in the lists of the Nine Children of the Dragon.

sources.title: 後漢書/卷40下 (Hou Hanshu, juan 40 bagian 2, catatan)
菽園雜記 (四庫全書標點本)/卷02 (Shuyuan zaji, juan 2)
sources.author: Lu Rong (陸容)

claims.quote: Pulao (Chinese: 蒲牢), known in some early sources also as tulao (徒牢), and Pu Lao, is a Chinese dragon, and one of the nine sons of the dragon. It is said in Chinese mythology that he likes to "roar", and therefore he is traditionally depicted on top of bells in China, and used as the hook by which the bells are hung.

statement.id: Pulao adalah naga Tiongkok yang termasuk sembilan anak naga.
statement.en: Pulao is a Chinese dragon counted among the nine dragon offspring.

claims.quote: Pulao (Chinese: 蒲牢), known in some early sources also as tulao (徒牢), and Pu Lao, is a Chinese dragon, and one of the nine sons of the dragon. It is said in Chinese mythology that he likes to "roar", and therefore he is traditionally depicted on top of bells in China, and used as the hook by which the bells are hung.

statement.id: Kegemarannya meraung dihubungkan dengan hiasan dan kait pada lonceng.
statement.en: Its roaring explains why China places Pulao images on bells as suspension hooks.

claims.quote: Pulao appeared in Chinese literature already during the Tang dynasty. The Tang dynasty scholar Li Shan (李善, 630–689), in his comments on Ban Gu's (32–92 AD) "Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody" (東都賦, Dong Du Fu), wrote:

statement.id: Li Shan mencatat Pulao dalam komentarnya atas Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody.
statement.en: Li Shan records Pulao in his commentary on the Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody.

claims.quote: In the sea there is a big fish called whale, and on the shore there is a creature whose name is pulao. The pulao has always been afraid of the whale. Whenever the whale strikes [or attacks] him, pulao cries [or roars] loudly. Thus those who want to make a loud [bell] would put a pulao on top. Therefore the bell-striker would be made [in the shape of] a whale.

statement.id: Kisah menjelaskan raungan Pulao sebagai reaksi terhadap paus yang ditakutinya.
statement.en: The tale explains Pulao's roar as a response to the whale it fears.

claims.quote: During the Ming dynasty, the pulao (in the form tulao) appeared in the influential list of fantastic creatures appearing in architecture and applied art, which was compiled by Lu Rong (1436-1494) in his Miscellaneous records from the bean garden (菽園雜記, Shuyuan zaji).

statement.id: Daftar Lu Rong pada zaman Ming menyertakan Pulao dengan nama Tulao.
statement.en: Lu Rong's Ming-period list includes Pulao under the name Tulao.

claims.quote: 薛綜注西京賦云：「海中有大魚名鯨，又有獸名蒲牢。蒲牢素畏鯨魚，鯨魚擊蒲牢，蒲牢輒大鳴呼。

statement.id: Catatan dalam teks ini mengutip Xue Zong yang menyebut ada binatang bernama Pulao (蒲牢) yang sejak dulu takut kepada ikan paus; setiap kali paus memukulnya, Pulao menjerit keras.
statement.en: A note in this text quotes Xue Zong saying there is a beast named Pulao (蒲牢) that has always feared the whale; whenever the whale strikes it, Pulao cries out loudly.

claims.quote: 蒲牢輒大鳴呼。凡鐘欲令其聲大者，故作蒲牢於其上，撞鐘者名為鯨魚。

statement.id: Catatan yang sama menyebut bahwa untuk membuat bunyi lonceng keras, Pulao dibuat di atasnya, dan pemukul lonceng dinamai ikan paus.
statement.en: The same note says that to make a bell sound loud, a Pulao is made on top of it, and the bell-striker is named a whale.

claims.quote: 螭吻，其形似獸，性好望，故立屋角上。徒牢，其形似龍而小，性吼呌，有神力，故懸於鐘上。

statement.id: Daftar dalam Shuyuan zaji menyebut Tulao (徒牢) berwujud seperti naga tetapi kecil, bersifat suka meraung, memiliki kekuatan gaib, sehingga lonceng digantungkan padanya.
statement.en: The list in the Shuyuan zaji says the Tulao (徒牢) looks like a dragon but small, is by nature given to roaring, has divine strength, and so bells are hung from it.

claims.quote: Later on, the pulao, with similar descriptions, was integrated into various lists of the Nine Children of the Dragon compiled by later Ming dynasty authors such as Li Dongyang and Yang Shen.

statement.id: Menurut artikel ini, Pulao kemudian dimasukkan ke berbagai daftar Sembilan Anak Naga yang disusun penulis Ming belakangan seperti Li Dongyang dan Yang Shen.
statement.en: According to the article, Pulao was later integrated into various lists of the Nine Children of the Dragon compiled by later Ming authors such as Li Dongyang and Yang Shen.
